visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, brownish-blonde hair and a black top is seen in a medium close-up shot. She smiles warmly at the camera, touching her cheeks with both hands to showcase her makeup. The background is a simple indoor room with a beige wall and a white door frame, illuminated by soft, bright indoor lighting. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white skincare tube and a pack of cleansing wipes held in a white bag. The woman's hands hold the products towards the lens. Subtitles appear at the bottom explaining the routine. The scene transitions quickly with sharp cuts between product angles. (3) The woman is back on screen, squeezing a white makeup remover cream onto her palm. She applies the cream to her forehead, cheeks, and lips, rubbing it in with gentle circular motions. The camera maintains a medium close-up, capturing her facial expressions and the texture of the white cream on her skin. (4) Using a white fiber wipe, she gently wipes away the makeup and cream from her face. She looks directly into the camera while cleaning her skin, demonstrating the effectiveness of the wipe. The lighting remains consistent, highlighting the transition from a made-up face to a clean one. (5) After cleaning her face, she touches her skin with her fingertips, smiling and nodding to show satisfaction. The video concludes with a black screen featuring a white brand logo and a website address. The woman appears happy and confident throughout the entire sequence.
